text: Scout makes the IDEXX order, but IDEXX asks its own questions. Until you answer them and click Order, the sample has no requisition.
Remember: the order isn't at IDEXX until you click Order in IDEXX's page.
Juniper's CBC was sent, but not finished. Open the line.
Click Finish in IDEXX.
This is IDEXX's own order page, inside Scout. Dr. Lane is already the vet.
Open Notes,
type a short note for the lab,
and click Done.
Dr. Lane also wants a urinalysis. Click Search All Tests,
and search for it.
Search all IDEXX tests,
and pick Urinalysis.
IDEXX needs specimen details for it. Click Specimen Details.
How was the urine collected?
Any medication?
A line of history,
and Done.
Now click Order.
IDEXX has it, and the window closes. The urinalysis you added is on Juniper's bill already, tagged Added in IDEXX.
The CBC now says Not at IDEXX yet, until the lab has the sample.
Print the requisition here and send it with the sample.
If IDEXX's page was closed before you clicked Order, the line says Finish in IDEXX. Click it to pick up where you left off.
The most common mistake: closing IDEXX's page without clicking Order. Remember: the order isn't at IDEXX until you click Order in IDEXX's page.
